definitionZh: 邻接的梳理器(+)将两个选择器分离出来,只有当它立即跟随第一个元素时才匹配第二个元素,两者都是同父元素的孩子.
sourceDefinition: The next-sibling combinator (+) separates two selectors and matches the second element only if it immediately follows the first element, and both are children of the same parent element.
